proposed_widenings.name: disbelieve_illusion
proposed_widenings.justification: The Study-action Investigation check's onPass effect is that the creature can see through the image and its other sensory qualities become faint. This is a creature-specific perception state change with deterministic mechanical consequences (the creature bypasses the illusion's concealment). No existing EffectAtom captures a creature-local illusion bypass/reveal. { kind: 'none' } was used as a known-gap placeholder to get the gate structure into the trace. Same gap as Silent Image.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and its other sensory qualities become faint to the creature.

proposed_widenings.name: concentration.permanentAtSlot
proposed_widenings.justification: At slot 4+, the duration changes from concentration (up to 10 minutes) to permanent (until dispelled, no concentration). The existing DurationUpcastTier only supports amount changes within the same duration kind; there is no mechanism to change the kind (concentration → permanent) at a slot threshold. The True Polymorph permanentIfMaintainedFull flag is maintenance-based, not slot-based — a different shape is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring Concentration, if cast with a level 4+ spell slot.

notes: Typecheck and tracer both pass. The trace correctly captures: ongoing_effect family; area attachment (cube 20 ft, point_within_range, range 120 ft); create_illusion with all four sensory channels (visual/sound/smell/temperature); reposition_attachment via on_caster_spends_action Magic action; on_creature_studies + ability_check_gate (Int vs caster spell save DC) for disbelief. Two mechanics are omitted: (1) onPass atom for 'sees through illusion' — { kind: none } placeholder, same acknowledged gap as Silent Image; (2) upcast-to-permanent at slot 4+ — no DurationUpcastKindChange mechanism exists. Primary classification atom_widening (missing disbelieve_illusion); secondary surface_widening (slot-based duration kind change).
